authorship: Codex-authored from hosted sources before any ranking runs; human relevance review pending.
limitations: Single known target per query; alternative relevant results are not judged.
Source-selected paraphrases are development checks, not held-out user queries.
Exact-tail probes deterministically select the twelve longest early sections and approximately their final 180 characters; they diagnose truncation, not general relevance.
The longest sections include a Latin appendix and editorial commentary; labels do not assert that all indexed text is ancient narrative.
